source_claims.quote: Almost always, the god has a full beard, wears a simple himation robe, and holds a staff (the bakteria) with a sacred snake coiled around it, which has become the modern symbol of medicine.

statement.en: Asklepios was depicted as a kindly, bearded man holding a serpent-entwined staff.

source_claims.quote: He is commonly represented standing, dressed in a long cloak, with bare breast; his usual attribute is a club-like staff with a serpent (the symbol of renovation) coiled round it. statement.id: Ia biasanya digambarkan berdiri berjubah panjang berdada terbuka dengan atribut tongkat bak gada berlilit ular (lambang pembaruan); ia sering ditemani Telesphorus, anak jenius penyembuhan, dan putrinya Hygieia, dewi kesehatan.
statement.en: He is commonly shown standing in a long cloak with bare breast, with a club-like staff coiled by a serpent (symbol of renovation) as his usual attribute; he is often accompanied by Telesphorus, the boy genius of healing, and his daughter Hygieia, goddess of health.

source_claims.quote: He grew so skilled in the craft that he was able to restore the dead to life. This was a crime against the natural order and so Zeus destroyed him with a thunderbolt.

statement.en: He grew so skilled that he could restore the dead to life; this was a crime against the natural order, so Zeus destroyed him with a thunderbolt.

source_claims.quote: His skill in curing disease and restoring the dead to life aroused the anger of Zeus, who, being afraid that he might render all men immortal, slew him with a thunderbolt

statement.en: His skill in curing disease and restoring the dead to life aroused Zeus's anger; fearing he might make all men immortal, Zeus slew him with a thunderbolt.

source_claims.quote: The god was particularly worshipped at the sanctuary of Epidaurus (founded in the 6th century BCE), known as the Asklepieion
